linux.reason: The official site publishes Linux x64 packages, but the current v2 binary is not source-published and the available v1 source does not establish the v2 Linux config, input, save, state, firmware, and key paths as one compatible contract.
evidence: official:https://retrovirtualmachine.org/download/ lists v2.1.20 Linux x64 .deb and .zip artifacts
source:README.md says v2.0.7 and later multi-host implementation is not open source @e2b3cbeda8f9
official:https://retrovirtualmachine.org/doc/ states the documentation section is still being developed

linux-flatpak.reason: The official download page lists Linux archives and a .deb but no Flatpak package or manifest.

windows.reason: The official site publishes a Windows x64 binary, but current v2 persistence and controller paths are not source-published; the pinned v1 source is macOS-only and cannot safely describe v2 Windows behavior.
evidence: official:https://retrovirtualmachine.org/ lists Windows among supported hosts
official:https://retrovirtualmachine.org/download/ lists the v2.1.20 Windows x64 artifact
source:README.md limits the public source branch to macOS and says current multi-host v2 is not open source @e2b3cbeda8f9

macos.reason: The official site publishes a macOS v2 artifact and the v1 source exposes a macOS .rvm document and gamepads.json implementation, but no source-backed proof shows those v1 formats remain compatible with the current v2 release.
evidence: source:Architectures/rvmArchitecture.m and Input/rvmInputManager.m establish v1 .rvm/gzip-JSON and gamepads.json paths @e2b3cbeda8f9

controller_boundary.refusal: Do not invent a Retro Virtual Machine controller writer: the current v2 desktop release is not source-published, and the pinned v1 HID mapping bytes are not a verified cross-version contract.

notes: Retro Virtual Machine v2.1.20 is distributed for Windows, macOS and Linux; no official Flatpak is listed. The last public source is v1.1.x for macOS, so current runtime launch, persistence and effective controller input remain unverified.
